items: Mix water, sugar, and yeast lightly. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Beat eggs and oil together; add to yeast mixture along with salt.
Add 3 cups flour and mix well. Add 4 more cups flour and stir well.
Add more flour as needed a little at a time to make a workable dough.
Let rise until double, punch down, and let rise again until double.
Punch down again and form into 2 or 3 loaves. Place in greased loaf pans.
Cover with a towel and let rise again until almost double.
Bake for 10 minutes at 400°F, then 25 minutes at 350°F.
